test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In 2018, the Uttar Pradesh government launched the ODOP scheme to promote competitive and important products from a region so as to develop an economic geographical model. What is the full form of ODOP?
solution:
The correct answer is __**One District One Product**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **One District One Product (ODOP)** scheme was launched by the Uttar Pradesh government in 2018.
 
• The scheme aims to promote competitive and important products from each district to develop an economic geographical model.
 
• It focuses on generating employment and providing support to local artisans and manufacturers, thereby boosting the local economy.
 
• Under this scheme, each district is recognized for a unique product that has the potential for growth and export.
 
• The initiative is designed to create product-specific traditional industrial hubs across the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The ODOP scheme is part of a broader vision to make Uttar Pradesh a trillion-dollar economy.
 
• It aligns with the Make in India initiative by focusing on indigenous products and craftsmanship.
 
• The scheme provides support in terms of training, financial assistance, and marketing to ensure the success of the identified products.
 
• It also encourages the use of modern technology and innovation to enhance the quality and productivity of these products.
 
• ODOP has been recognized as a significant step towards preserving and promoting traditional crafts and industries.
